messages:
Ava (PM): Quick async check on the Finishline Q quarterly OKR — what shipped this sprint, what slipped, and any CR pings we should escalate? Please keep responses short. cc @eng-runtime @devex

Devon: Shipping: routing service canary + embed-cache landed in staging. PRs #748 and #762 merged. Observed ~12% p50 latency drop in staging. :tada:

Priya: Slipped: offline-batching job rollback — hitting KV-seed error when seq > 2048. Triage in progress, looks like a padding/offset bug in the cache layer. Blocking on a Dedicated infra flag change. CC @eng-infra.

Marta: CR queue: I'm blocked waiting on a review for the runtime PR that tweaks attention caching — PR #771. Need another pair to validate perf + regression tests.

Kai: I'll take PR #771 today, timeline EOD. Heads up: monitoring alert flapping seen in staging tied to telemetry schema change, might be related to the regression.

release-bot: release-bot: Deploy started for routing-canny to prod at 2024-05-03T14:22Z

Devon: Quick recap / next steps: Priya to triage the KV-seed error and surface an actionable fix, Marta + Kai to pair-review and run perf tests, Leo to prep a rollback runbook if canary degrades. Who owns the infra flag change?

Leo: I can own the rollback plan and the canary toggle. Will draft a short runbook with exact commands and rollback criteria, posting to the runbooks channel in ~90m.

Ava (PM): Owners ack? Also list any dependent teams impacted (client SDKs, persistence, etc.) so we can ping them proactively.

Priya: Persistence team is impacted by the KV schema — Sam on persistence is looped. Sam, can you confirm if a schema bump would block client SDKs?

Sam: Sam: We can do a non-breaking schema bump; it requires a client minor version bump but won't block rollout. ETA tomorrow morning for the client PR.

Kai: For the CR/perf queue, suggestion: prioritize running the perf CI with higher sequence lengths to catch this earlier: `make test-perf SEQ=4096` — adds ~5m to CI but catches KV cache regressions.

Marta: Thanks, Kai. I'll run `make test-perf SEQ=4096` locally and post results in ~30m.

Ava (PM): Nice. I'll prepare a one-slide status for execs: shipped = routing canary, embed-cache; slipped = offline-batch/KV-seed; actions = triage (Priya), CR pairing (Marta+Kai), rollback runbook (Leo), client readiness (Sam).

Devon: +1. If anything blocks Priya's triage (infra flags), ping me and I'll escalate to eng-infra on-call.

Ava (PM): Thanks everyone — I'll mark this thread as the Finishline milestone async update. If there are major changes, reply here; otherwise I'll close the loop by EOD and update the OKR tracker. :white_check_mark:
